name: food_delivery_order_stats
description: The Python loop that summed item totals per order was replaced by a single SQL aggregation query to cut data transfer and memory usage.
flaw: The aggregation query in optimized/main.py is missing 'GROUP BY oi.order_id'. With SUM() but no GROUP BY, SQLite collapses every matching row into a single row: all orders' items are summed together and the total is keyed to one arbitrary order id, so every order's total is wrong and most orders are missing from the result.
